# Rainier Valley Dispatch

> The Rainier Valley Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Seattle, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Rainier Valley](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Rainier Valley news](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/news/): every story, newest first
- [Reader asked](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/asked/): readers' questions answered from the public record
- [Standards](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Columbia City](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/columbia-city/): The Rainier Avenue South business district, the Columbia City light rail station on Martin Luther King Jr. Way South and Columbia Park.
- [Hillman City](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/hillman-city/): Rainier Avenue South around South Orcas Street, between Columbia City and Seward Park, with the Hillman City business district.
- [Seward Park](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/seward-park/): The streets west of the Seward Park peninsula, with its old-growth forest, the beach and the Lake Washington Boulevard South shoreline.
- [Mount Baker](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/mount-baker/): The hillside over Lake Washington with Mount Baker Park, Colman Park, Mount Baker Boulevard and the Mount Baker light rail station.
- [Rainier Beach](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/rainier-beach/): The south end of the valley, with the Rainier Beach light rail station, Pritchard Island Beach, Kubota Garden and the Rainier Beach community center.
- [Brighton](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/brighton/): Between Hillman City and Rainier Beach around Martin Luther King Jr. Way South, with Brighton Playfield and the Othello light rail station.
- [Beacon Hill](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/beacon-hill/): The ridge south of Jefferson Park through Mid-Beacon and South Beacon Hill, along Beacon Avenue South and the Chief Sealth Trail.
- [North Beacon Hill](https://www.rainiervalleydispatch.com/north-beacon-hill/): The north end of the ridge, with Jefferson Park, the Beacon Hill light rail station and the Beacon Avenue South business district.
